title: VIXEN configure requires manual UNDERTOW_ROOT for Text
body: cx-glyphtext: the documented vixen-wsl preset failed before semantic edits with Text requires UNDERTOW_ROOT at VIXEN/libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt:5; configure succeeded only after adding UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/glyphtext. Suggested consolidation: discover the paired Undertow root from worktree/launcher context or provide paired-root setup.

title: Historical VIXEN snapshot re-downloads Vulkan SDK instead of using shared cache
body: cx-glyphtext: detached 68154e05 snapshot could not discover the shared Vulkan SDK and auto-downloaded a local SDK under the snapshot; configure only proceeded after provisioning inside that snapshot. Suggested consolidation: make pinned SDK/cache discovery stable across detached worktrees.

title: GPU witness queue can be held behind a stale benchmark closing gate
body: The required GlyphSdf GPU witness was queued through /home/liory/.local/bin/with-test-lock.sh but remained refused at gate=head-order for more than 24 minutes while the status reported free GPU capacity, because an unrelated full-gpu-final job kept the benchmark window in closing. The facade/workflow should provide a force-independent witness mode or reliably clear stale benchmark ownership without bypassing the shared queue.
